introHtml:
Marketing directors and business owners sourcing promotional items for families need products that are safe, practical, and genuinely useful. Custom child infant products from Perfect Imprints help you reach parents and caregivers with items they will appreciate and use daily. Whether for hospital welcome kits, parenting events, or employee family programs, these products build goodwill and keep your brand visible in a household context.

Our selection includes essentials like the Click-It Kit for car seat safety, MagPatch for easy identification, and the Dan™ Denim Tote for stylish storage. From the practical Glass Bento Box for lunches to the fun Chocolate Coins for treats, each item can be customized with your logo. We focus on non-toxic materials, rounded edges, and age-appropriate designs so you can feel confident in your giveaway.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom child infant products, prioritize safety and durability. Look for items made from BPA-free plastics, lead-free metals, and non-toxic finishes. Products like the Click-It Kit and MagPatch are designed with child safety in mind, featuring secure fastenings and soft edges. Always request material safety data sheets from your supplier to ensure compliance with U.S. consumer safety standards.

Materials and Build Quality

Infant products must withstand frequent use and cleaning. Choose items with reinforced stitching, shatterproof materials, and easy-to-clean surfaces. For example, the Dan™ Denim Tote offers sturdy fabric that holds up to daily outings, while the Glass Bento Box uses tempered glass for durability. Avoid items with small detachable parts that could pose choking hazards.

Common Use Cases

These products are ideal for hospital discharge programs, parenting workshops, and employee family events. Marketing directors use branded child infant products to connect with new parents, while HR directors include them in family-friendly onboarding kits. Safety managers appreciate items like the Click-It Kit for promoting car seat safety. Trade show giveaways at baby expos also benefit from practical items like the Puffer Belt Bag or Pro-AM Shoe Bag.

Decoration Options

Customization methods vary by product. Screen printing works well on fabric items like tote bags and shoe bags. Pad printing is suitable for hard surfaces like the Ruler Keytag or Boutique Comb. For a premium look, consider laser engraving on metal items like the Hammer Keytag. Full-color heat transfer is ideal for items with complex logos, such as the NFC Slim Pen. Always test decoration on a sample to ensure adhesion and color accuracy.

Quantity Guidance

Minimum order quantities (MOQs) for child infant products typically range from 100 to 500 units per design. Bulk orders of 1,000 or more significantly reduce per-unit costs. For example, ordering 500 Click-It Kits may cost $3 each, while 2,000 units could drop to $2.25. Plan ahead for lead times of 2-4 weeks for decorated items. If you need a small test run, ask about sample programs before committing to a large quantity.

Common Buying Mistakes

Avoid selecting items with sharp edges or small parts that require additional safety testing. Verify that all components are dishwasher-safe if the product will be used with food. Another pitfall is ordering too few units for a large event; always add 10-15% for spillover. Finally, confirm that the decoration method is compatible with the product material to prevent peeling or fading after washing.

faqs.q: What safety standards do these products meet?
faqs.a: All our child infant products comply with U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) guidelines. We use BPA-free plastics, lead-free metals, and non-toxic finishes. Certifications are available upon request for bulk orders.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: MOQs vary by product but typically start at 100 units. For example, custom MagPatch orders require a minimum of 250 pieces. Contact us for specific product MOQs and pricing.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer samples of most products. You can order a blank sample for a small fee, or a decorated sample with your logo for a slightly higher cost. Samples usually ship within 5 business days.

We offer screen printing, pad printing, laser engraving, and full-color heat transfer. The best method depends on the product material and logo complexity. Our team can recommend the right option for your design.
Standard production lead time is 10-15 business days after artwork approval. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. Shipping time depends on the carrier and destination.
